item.title: Clean Sweep 0.7.0 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.7.0 Preview
- **Review Results** opens the latest processed collection, opens Remove, and selects the generated pin for you. Previous / Next Removal continues across photos; Previous / Next Variation compares that removal's existing results. - The compact window centers the heading and filename, uses Lightroom's **Variation** language, and shows the live **1/3**, **2/3**, or **3/3** value inside the controls. Clay, sage, parchment, and charcoal match the Clean Sweep logo and Legacy Lab palette. - On Mac, **Enable Clean Sweep Keyboard** turns on left / right for removals, up / down for variations, **R** for **Generate 3 New Variations**, and **Esc** to finish. The toggle clearly shows whether keyboard control is enabled. Lightroom's own variation shortcut remains visible as a reminder. - Generation saves a recovery snapshot and submits once. Held keys, duplicate requests, stale selections, and changed pins cannot silently submit another request. Unconfirmed generations stay held for inspection across reloads; other removals remain available. - Review follows manual selection of processed photos while active and pauses when you leave the collection. Done or closing the window keeps your choices and allows any already submitted generation to finish. Update notices wait until review ends.
Tested in Lightroom Classic 15.6 using two synthetic fixture photos: native buttons and keys, cross-photo navigation, regenerated variations, preservation of masks and unrelated repairs, stale-request rejection, and saved review identity after reload. Windows, other Lightroom versions, real-photo review, Smart Preview-only use, and long sessions still need broader acceptance testing.
Finish or stop your batch and close the status window before replacing the complete plug-in folder, then reload it in Plug-in Manager. Keep the Mac companion inside **CleanSweep.lrplugin**. Saved queues and preferences remain in place. See the included README if migrating from a folder named **RemovalQueue.lrplugin**.
